thread:
incidents-bot: 🚨 Alert: sudden spike in 5xx/timeouts for /v1/generate (eu-west-1). p95 ~ 1.8s -> 6.2s, p99 ~ 3.9s -> 12.4s. Error rate (5xx) up 6x in last 5m. Canary cohort shows same.

alice (oncall): ack, I'm on it. paging rotations.

ben (sre): looking at traces + gateway logs now. prelim: upstream connection pool saturation + long tails on a single model replica set.

carol (release): this started ~ 7432108800 according to deploy events — we pushed a canary of runtime change ~ 10m ago.

alice (oncall): roll event id?

carol (release): deploy-bot shows `deploy/edge-runtime v2.17.4` -> canary 10%. commit `f3a9c4b`. link: https://ci.redwood/deploys/f3a9c4b

ben (sre): running quick query:
```
# prometheus
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="api",route="/v1/generate",code=~"5..",region="eu-west-1"}[5m]))
```
results: 5xx spike concentrated on hostpool `gpu-pool-3` replicas.

ben (sre): also seeing KV cache ejections spikes and high cpu on replica nodes. KV miss ratio up.

alice (oncall): can we partial-rollback the canary? reduce to 0% and force old canary?

carol (release): I can cut traffic now. executing rollback to `v2.17.3` on canary.

deploy-bot: Executing canary rollback: set-traffic canary=0% for deploy f3a9c4b -> success.

incidents-bot: Noted action: canary rollback complete at 7432109950. Monitor p95/p99 for next 5m.

ben (sre): immediate telemetry looks promising — p99 dropped from 12.4s -> 2.1s within 30s. error-rate trending down.

alice (oncall): nice. keep monitoring. any customer-facing impact detected?

eve (support): Support queue: ~12 new tickets flagged with timeouts from EU during window. Two customers reported degraded latency (non-blocking), no downtime tickets yet. I'll draft status message.

ben (sre): root cause triage snapshot: new kernel flag in v2.17.4 changed connection keepalive handling on GPU hosts -> increased connection churn under certain request mix -> KV eviction + queueing -> tail latency. Need deeper replay.

carol (release): tagging release for rollback and blocking v2.17.4 from progressing. PR to revert is opened: https://git.redwood/reverts/1234

alice (oncall): handoff: I'll continue watch for 15 more minutes then hand to dino. Please add post-mortem ticket.

dino (oncall-next): taking handoff at 7432110400. ping me if it resurges.

eve (support): status draft: "We observed elevated timeouts for text generation in EU for ~10m affecting a subset of requests. Engineers rolled back a recent runtime canary and service metrics are recovering. We're investigating root cause and will follow up." Approve?

alice (oncall): approve, add ETA: investigating, impact: partial errors/timeouts, mitigated by rollback. :thumbsup:

ben (sre): next steps: collect kernel + runtime env from failing replicas, run replay with synthetic load matching prefix distribution, run canary with keepalive reverted. Opening tracking issue: INF-2026.

carol (release): I'm blocking further canary promotions until we merge the revert and validate in staging.

incidents-bot: Incident timeline recorded. Suggested severity: Sev2 (customer impact, mitigated).

alice (oncall): thanks team. leaving notes in the incident doc and adding link to traces + logs. short postmortem to follow.

dino (oncall-next): standing by. I'll escalate to infra if we see a second spike.

ben (sre): logs/snippet linking:
```
ERROR upstream=api-gpu-03 conn-reset after 120s wait, queue-depth=64
KV-eviction: triggered=1.8k/m
```

alice (oncall): final: rollback succeeded, p99 stabilized ~2s, support notified, oncall handoff done. closing urgent mitigation phase.

incidents-bot: Incident closed for mitigation at 7432110400 (watch mode)."
